reading.synthesisOpeningWithQuestion: For the question "{{question}}", your {{topic}} reading unfolds as follows.
reading.synthesisMajorHeavy: With several Major Arcana cards appearing, this moment seems tied less to small daily matters and more to an important turning point in your life.
reading.synthesisAllMinor: With mostly Minor Arcana cards appearing, concrete everyday choices and attitudes -- rather than dramatic events -- are shaping this flow.
reading.synthesisReversedHeavy: With reversed cards standing out, it's worth paying attention to what's still settling beneath the surface, or moving more slowly than expected, rather than what's plainly visible.
reading.synthesisAllUpright: With every card upright, the current flow is relatively smooth and its direction is clearly visible.
reading.synthesisFlow: The flow that began with {{firstName}} in the {{firstPosition}} position leads into {{lastName}} in the {{lastPosition}} position. Take a moment to consider each card in its place, and what you truly need right now.

learn.title: Learn Tarot
learn.description: A short guide for those new to tarot.
learn.cardsBody: Tarot is a symbolic system of 78 cards. The 22 Major Arcana show the large turning points of life, while the 56 Minor Arcana (Wands, Cups, Swords, Pentacles) show concrete everyday situations and feelings.
learn.orientationBody: The same card drawn upright tends to show its meaning clearly and smoothly, while reversed it often means that meaning is held inward, delayed, or expressed differently. Reversed does not automatically mean something bad.
learn.spreadBody: A spread is the way cards are laid out and the meaning given to each position. The same card is read differently in a "Past" position than in an "Advice" position.
learn.usageStep1: Choose a reading from the home page or the top menu.
learn.usageStep2: Decide how many cards to draw and, if you like, write down your question.
learn.usageStep4: Choose your own cards from the deck laid out before you.
learn.usageStep5: If you like the result, save it and revisit it later in your "Vault".

footer.tagline: A quiet moment to reflect, with the tarot as your guide.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.body1: This site runs entirely in your browser, with no server. Your questions, drawn cards, and reading history are stored only in this browser's local storage and are never sent elsewhere.
privacy.body2: There is no sign-up or login, so we do not collect personal information such as email addresses or passwords. Clearing your browser storage also clears your saved readings.
privacy.body3: Your language preference is kept in the same local storage so it is remembered on your next visit.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.body1: THE ARCANA is a tarot reading service intended for entertainment and self-reflection. Its interpretations are not a substitute for professional legal, medical, or financial advice -- please consult a professional for important decisions.
terms.body2: The card illustrations, text, and design on this site are original content.
terms.body3: The service may change or be discontinued without prior notice.
